rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: In the statement the INC publishes under the title 'Statement issued by Congress President Shri Rahul Gandhi', Rahul Gandhi says that as President he is responsible for the 2019 loss and 'It is for this reason that I have resigned as Congress President'; he says he will not select his successor and that 'Immediately after resigning' he suggested to Working Committee colleagues that a group begin the search for a new President.
